name: Silver Street, Eastern End
desc1: This is a cobblestoned street. It is dimly lit by guttering lanterns
desc2: hung from tall posts. It is quiet and nearly deserted here, mostly due
desc3: to the fact that the city gates have been closed for some time as the
desc4: frequency of highway robbers has increased. You can see the city gates
desc5: off to the east, and Silver street contines off towards the town
